annotations.title: Set where the agent may speak, and how it looks

description: Choose where the agent may speak and what those places look like: which layout surfaces are enabled, whether the exit modal is allowed, custom CSS, and per-surface HTML. Markup and CSS are re-checked against an allowlist on every visitor — anything that could run, or fetch a remote resource, is silently removed, so compare what comes back with what you sent. Needs the surfaces permission.

allowModal.description: Allow the page-blocking exit modal. Off by default.

customCss.description: CSS applied inside the intervention's shadow root. An empty string clears it.

enabled.description: Surfaces the agent may use: inline_hint, card, sticky_bar, bottom_sheet, inline_block, cta_tooltip.

siteId.description: Which site this call is about. Only needed when your credential covers more than one — cromanion_grants lists them and says whether it is required. Omitting it with several is refused rather than guessed at.

templates.description: Per-surface HTML, keyed by surface. Use {{message}}, {{cta_label}} and {{cta_url}} as placeholders.

name: cromanion_set_surfaces

customCss.description: The CSS as STORED — compare with what you sent to see what the allowlist removed.

templates.description: Per-surface, what was kept and what was stripped from your markup.
